verdict.rationale: Scribe is an API-first service with an HTTP and WebSocket API, API-key authentication, official Python and Node.js SDKs, and asynchronous webhook delivery, so it can run headlessly inside automated pipelines without a UI. Missing for 10: CI-specific documentation or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions recipes), a dedicated CLI, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
